feature_contract.goal: Route genuine live-game D3D9 programmable SM3 one-pixel POINTLIST draws, indexed and nonindexed, through the native full-resolution D3D11 POINTLIST IA Draw/DrawIndexed path without sacrificing original D3D9 rendering/input/FFB for unsupported point modes.
feature_contract.scope_boundary: Only source-owned live SM3 native POINTLIST and associated source-bound positive/negative regressions; preserve shader, texture, depth, blend, source VB/IB/UP bindings, all preexisting primitive families, original D3D9/DX9Ex fallback and frozen DXVK. No claim of real-game, Quest3 or HMD validation.

acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Original game programmable unit-size point primitives reach native D3D11 POINTLIST IA using authentic point vertex/index spans, shader and render state.

Point sprites, scaled/non-unit/nonfinite or invalid point sizes, declaration PSIZE, and failed D3D9 point raster state reads reject native GPU submission before state mutation and retain original D3D9 draw/input/FFB.

DX11 Fast, Backend Conversion Gate, Windows Build, OpenXR architecture and HUD Inspector all succeed on the same validation-bearing code SHA, with positive and negative source-linked regressions; hardware/gameplay remain UNTESTED.

integration_path: Intercept genuine live D3D9 SM3 POINTLIST indexed and nonindexed draw spans
Check authentic one-pixel render states and reject sprites, scale and PSIZE before native GPU mutation
Issue D3D11 POINTLIST IA and native Draw/DrawIndexed while keeping original D3D9 fallback
